title: POGGERS Create & Catch
body:
A modpack focused on Create and Cobblemon, Poggers, the Modpack has several other mods to ensure interesting and diverse gameplay, with new world generation, new biomes, mobs, items and much more! 

Created to play on a server with several people, it has many features to promote fun gameplay for all players, many adventure options for all tastes. 

The modpack also comes with the Distant Horizons mod and the Iris shaders mod, providing beautiful graphics to make your gameplay even more exciting and immersive.
